entities.name: Time Synchronization Feature
entities.description: A 5GS feature that supports time synchronization and Time Sensitive Communication (TSC) as defined in 3GPP specifications TS 23.501, TS 23.502, and TS 23.503.

entities.name: NAS-specific Aspects
entities.description: NAS-specific aspects of 5GS features for time synchronization and TSC, described in this clause.

entities.name: EPS Interworking Restriction
entities.description: Interworking with EPS is not supported for PDU sessions used for time synchronization or TSC.

entities.name: PDU Session for TSC
entities.description: A PDU session specifically used for Time Sensitive Communication or time synchronization purposes.

relations.description: The time synchronization feature has NAS-specific aspects described in this clause.
PDU sessions for time synchronization or TSC are subject to the condition that EPS interworking is not supported.
